Months of decisions, reasons and results shouldn't stay behind when you change computers.

S3 Brain exports a portable package, or a passphrase-protected recovery package that opens on another Mac, with a transfer guide that walks you through it. Two Macs never write the same memory at once.

You can also bring documents in:
· Import PDFs and HTML pages as references
· Each keeps its page or heading
· Each stays marked unverified, so it can't change a confirmed decision

Free for personal use, macOS 14 or later.
